method: Three independent contexts using a copied standalone skill. Consumer and public-service each had three simulated user turns in the same context; enterprise received a direct-output request. Parent reviewed saved outputs. Runners received no rubric or intended answer.
observed: ToC narrows to saving an activity through deciding whether to leave; no acquisition or enterprise approval checklist
Secondhand reports from two users remain bounded and unknown reasons are not invented
Skip and no-more-questions requests produce interim outputs and respondent-directed follow-ups
Public-facing service retains resident and organization perspectives; reservation review is distinct from service completion
Explicit ToB direct-output request bypasses interactive setup while retaining consequential gaps
limits: Simulated text exchanges, not native question UI interaction
No real customer interviews or population validation
Original v0.1.0 suite was not rerun in full
No global install, remote publication or live product verification
